sources.title: Microsoft outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot, disrupting thousands
Breaking: Microsoft platforms suffering widespread outages, including Outlook
Microsoft 365, Outlook down for thousands of US users, Downdetector shows
Microsoft’s Outlook email hit by new outage

en.title: Microsoft outage affected Outlook Teams Copilot on 12 November
en.dek: Microsoft platforms experienced service interruptions on Thursday, 12 November, affecting Outlook and other 365 tools.
facts: More than 120,000 users reported Outlook access issues on Downdetector by 12 November.
Microsoft reported that part of its infrastructure experienced elevated load, which it identified as a possible factor in the outage.
The disruption affected Outlook, Teams, Copilot, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Defender XDR, according to Microsoft's Service Health Status site.
Microsoft announced it was redistributing traffic and restarting affected servers to restore service.
OpenAI and Anthropic reported issues with Microsoft connectors during the outage.
body: Thousands of users experienced a service interruption at Microsoft on Thursday, 12 November, affecting Outlook, Teams, and Copilot, according to Euronews.

Downdetector reported that over 120,000 users in the United States reported difficulties accessing Outlook around 1:30 p.m. Eastern time, and this number rose to over 130,000, according to data reported by Downdetector.

Microsoft stated in updates on X that it initially received reports about users unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes in the Americas, and later identified elevated load on some infrastructure as a possible cause.

The company stated it resolved the Teams disruption in North America, while it also paused all deployments, moved additional traffic off affected infrastructure, and restarted servers to return services to operation.

Anthropic stated it identified an issue with an upstream provider affecting its Microsoft 365 connector, and OpenAI reported investigating issues with Microsoft connectors where new connections may be broken.
en.context: Microsoft's Service Health Status site confirmed users could not connect to multiple 365 services, including Exchange Online and Copilot 365, during the event.

de.title: Microsoft-Ausfall betraf Outlook, Teams und Copilot am 12. November
de.dek: Microsoft-Dienste erlebten am Donnerstag, 12. November, Störungen; betroffen waren Outlook und weitere 365-Tools.
facts: Mehr als 120.000 Nutzer meldeten Outlook-Zugriffsprobleme bei Downdetector bis zum 12. November
Microsoft gab an, Teile der Infrastruktur hätten erhöhte Last erfahren, was mögliche Ursache für den Ausfall sei
Die Störung betraf Outlook, Teams, Copilot, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online und Defender XDR, laut Microsoft-Statusseite
Microsoft kündigte an, Verkehr umzuleiten und betroffene Server neu zu starten, um den Dienst wiederherzustellen
OpenAI und Anthropic meldeten Probleme mit Microsoft-Schnittstellen während des Ausfalls
body: Tausende von Nutzern erlebten am Donnerstag, dem 12. November, einen Dienstausfall bei Microsoft, der Outlook, Teams und Copilot betraf, wie Euronews meldet.

Downdetector berichtete, dass über 120.000 Nutzer in den Vereinigten Staaten gegen 13:30 Uhr Eastern Time Schwierigkeiten beim Zugriff auf Outlook meldeten, wobei diese Zahl laut Downdetector auf über 130.000 stieg.

Microsoft gab in Updates auf X bekannt, dass es zunächst Berichte über Nutzer erhielt, die keinen Zugriff auf Exchange Online Postfächer in Amerika hatten, und später eine erhöhte Last auf einigen Infrastrukturen als mögliche Ursache identifizierte.

Das Unternehmen teilte mit, dass es die Störung bei Teams in Nordamerika behoben habe, während es zudem alle Bereitstellungen pausierte, zusätzlichen Datenverkehr von den betroffenen Infrastrukturen entfernte und Server neu startete, um den Dienst wiederherzustellen.

Anthropic gab bekannt, dass es ein Problem mit einem Upstream-Anbieter identifiziert habe, das seinen Microsoft 365 Connector beeinträchtigte, und OpenAI meldete, dass es Probleme mit Microsoft-Connectoren untersucht, bei denen neue Verbindungen unterbrochen sein könnten.
de.context: Microsoft-Statusseite bestätigte, dass Nutzer während des Ereignisses keinen Zugriff auf mehrere 365-Dienste, darunter Exchange Online und Copilot 365, hatten

it.title: Interruzione Microsoft colpisce Outlook, Teams e Copilot il 12 novembre
it.dek: Le piattaforme Microsoft hanno subito interruzioni di servizio giovedì 12 novembre, interessando Outlook e altri strumenti 365.
facts: Più di 120.000 utenti hanno segnalato problemi di accesso a Outlook su Downdetector entro il 12 novembre
Microsoft ha riferito che parte della sua infrastruttura ha subito un carico elevato, identificato come possibile fattore dell'interruzione
La disfunzione ha interessato Outlook, Teams, Copilot, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online e Defender XDR, secondo il sito di Stato della Salute del Servizio di Microsoft
Microsoft ha annunciato di aver ridistribuito il traffico e riavviato i server interessati per ripristinare il servizio
OpenAI e Anthropic hanno segnalato problemi con i connettori Microsoft durante l'interruzione
body: Migliaia di utenti hanno riscontrato un'interruzione del servizio di Microsoft giovedì 12 novembre, che ha interessato Outlook, Teams e Copilot, secondo Euronews.

Downdetector ha segnalato che oltre 120.000 utenti negli Stati Uniti hanno riportato difficoltà nell'accesso a Outlook intorno alle 13:30 ora orientale, e questo numero è salito oltre 130.000, secondo i dati forniti da Downdetector.

Microsoft ha comunicato su X di aver inizialmente ricevuto segnalazioni di utenti impossibilitati ad accedere alle caselle di posta Exchange Online nelle Americhe, identificando successivamente un carico elevato su alcune infrastrutture come causa possibile.

L'azienda ha dichiarato di aver risolto l'interruzione di Teams in Nord America, avendo inoltre sospeso tutti i deployment, spostato traffico aggiuntivo dalle infrastrutture interessate e riavviato i server per ripristinare i servizi.

Anthropic ha segnalato di aver identificato un problema con un fornitore a monte che ha interessato il suo connettore Microsoft 365, mentre OpenAI ha riferito di indagare su problemi relativi ai connettori Microsoft in cui le nuove connessioni potrebbero essere interrotte.
it.context: Il sito di Stato della Salute del Servizio di Microsoft ha confermato che gli utenti non potevano connettersi a più servizi 365, inclusi Exchange Online e Copilot 365, durante l'evento.

zh.title: 微软服务中断：Outlook、Teams、Copilot 受影响
zh.dek: 微软平台于周四（11月12日）出现服务中断，影响Outlook及其他365工具
facts: 更有12万名用户在Downdetector于11月12日报告Outlook访问问题
微软报告其基础设施出现负载激增，并将其识认为中断的可能因素
中断影响Outlook、Teams、Copilot、SharePoint Online、Exchange Online及Defender XDR，据微软服务健康状态网站称
微软宣布正在重新分配流量并重启受影响的服务器以恢复服务
OpenAI和Anthropic在中断期间报告了与微软连接器的问题
body: 微软周四（11月12日）出现服务中断，影响Outlook、Teams和Copilot，据Euronews报道。
据Downdetector显示，美国约有12万名用户在东部时间下午1点左右报告无法访问Outlook，该数字随后增至13万以上。
微软在X平台的更新中表示，最初收到用户无法访问美洲地区Exchange Online邮箱的报告，随后确定部分基础设施负载过高可能是原因。
该公司称已解决北美地区的Teams中断问题，同时暂停所有部署，将额外流量转移至非受影响基础设施，并重启服务器以恢复运营。
Anthropic表示，其Microsoft 365连接器出现上游供应商问题；OpenAI则报告正在调查Microsoft连接器的问题，新建连接可能已中断。
zh.context: 微软服务健康状态网站确认，在此期间用户无法连接多个365服务，包括Exchange Online和Copilot 365

problemsFixed: The headline uses an evaluative framing ('disrupts') and is not a purely factual statement of what happened.
The 'dek' is not a concise, one-sentence summary of what happened.
The 'facts' list contains unsupported claims (e.g., 'by 12 November 2026' without context on the reporting time, and the specific 130,000 figure is a reported maximum, not a confirmed fact).
The 'body' contains filler and violates rhythm rules (e.g., starting sentences with the same noun, ending paragraphs with summary statements).
The 'context' is speculative and not supported by the sources.
The structure violates PLAIN rules (e.g., no clear actor opening paragraphs, no variation in sentence length, and the final paragraph is an evaluative summary).
